 What happened to Brandon Miller? Hornets star exits with injury in NBA Cup vs Celtics 
 2026-11-07 01:07 
 Brandon Miller (groin) will not return for Hornets vs. Celtics.
 Credit: AP - Scanpix 
 Credit AP - Scanpix 
 Credit AP - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 Brandon Miller will not return for the Charlotte Hornets' Friday NBA Cup game against the Boston Celtics due to right groin soreness, the team announced .

 Miller suddenly entered the Hornets' locker room with 7:14 remaining in the second quarter.
 The NBA star dropped eight points on 3-of-10 shooting with two rebounds and an assist in 14 minutes before leaving. Charlotte trails Boston 70-39 at halftime.
 With Miller unavailable to return, Royce O'Neale, Tidjane Salaun, and Sion James will gain more minutes for the Hornets.
 Miller's groin injury serves as another gut-wrenching blow for the Hornets in their health department. Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (thigh) did not suit up for Friday's game with injuries.
